files.description: The registered EHI export documentation page. Single WordPress page describing the EHI export mechanism: C-CDA XML format, HTML format, FHIR DocumentReference, and FHIR Bulk Data export. Lists 25 C-CDA sections included in the export. No downloadable files linked from this page.

Auto-generated HAPI FHIR R4 server API reference (2,155 pages). Documents all standard FHIR R4 resource endpoints including $export bulk data operations. Linked as 'FHIR documentation' from the Certified EHR Technology disclosures page. This is a generic FHIR API reference, not EHI-export-specific.

CliniComp proprietary REST API documentation for USCDI data (42 pages, P/N 250-70079 Rev D, Jan 2024). Defines 20 CCDS/USCDI data objects with field-level data dictionaries (name, type, nullable, description, EHR Major IT identifier). Includes sample API requests, JSON responses, error handling, and a Full Patient Query mode (ccds.AllData). Also includes Terms of Use (pages 28-42). Linked as 'API documentation' from the Certified EHR Technology disclosures page.
Full-page screenshot of the registered EHI export documentation page, captured in Chrome. Shows the page title, introductory text, table of C-CDA sections, and the export format descriptions.
Full-page screenshot of the Certified EHR Technology – Costs & Disclosures page. Contains links to FHIR documentation, EHI export page, and API documentation PDFs.
